claim: Prospective source-fidelity panel preparation after an explicitly preserved stopped assessment. Not a score, independent biological reference or replacement of failed studies.

selection.rationale: All remaining metadata-eligible studies from the exact original saved directory and ranking; no further ranking, size-band change, publication-year change, biology/outcome filter or new source.
selection.size_rule: Original numeric PMID .txt filename and displayed binary K/M size 4096..65536 inclusive; rounded display is only selection metadata, not the eventual transport byte bound.
selection.ranking: Ascending SHA-256(UTF-8(salt + filename)), tie-break filename; original ranks 9..12, all four remaining eligible entries.
selection.transport_rule: Preserve original maximum of 65,536 actual MITAB bytes per exact URL, identity encoding, bounded nonempty HTTP 200 and no redirects. A later execution contract must also pin bounded exact XML URLs before any body access.
selection.no_replacement: No substitute for transport/format/provenance/eligibility failures. All selected publications and source rows remain accounted; zero eligible rows means not evaluable.
selection.adaptive_history: The new assessment is declared after the original comparator stop and its consumed-record diagnostic. Original selection, failure and results remain preserved; this is not a rerun labeled unseen.

known_exposure_boundary.DOI_alias_and_shared_primary_or_subsidia: not_audited; metadata filename disjointness does not imply independence
known_exposure_boundary.pair_participant_evidence_experiment_ove: not_audited; no new identities or interaction bodies accessed
known_exposure_boundary.bounded_inventory_must_expand_before_fut: Original inventory covers only four development studies plus four historical anchors. A future executor must include all eight now-consumed IntAct studies and preserve exact evidence/experiment/study provenance where supplied.

prospective_assessment_requirements: Integrate and pass controls for identity-qualified all database interaction IDs without broadening generic see-also into identity; preserve raw-v1 failure and consumed tests.
Freeze full actual corrected code/runtime, input/reader/license pins, deterministic question/order/batching/profile/caps and Pharos retrieval policy before any selected body retrieval or decoding.
Use unchanged explicit human-protein source eligibility, exact participant accessions/orientation, original semantic amendment and field/denominator rules.

Audit qualified primary/subsidiary dataset statements against all eight consumed IntAct studies plus bounded historical anchors; record ambiguous reuse as unresolved and exclude known consumed-linked components without replacement.
Report participant/pair/evidence/experiment exposure separately; ordinary shared proteins/pairs are flags, not automatic study exclusions.
Account all physical/evidence rows and source eligibility separately from lineage-qualified assessment denominator, including zero-eligible studies.
Use all eligible rows as coverage/strict-fidelity denominators, report conditional correctness, field/critical errors, publication macro counts and unevaluated empty strata.
One new fixed execution; unresolved reader/reference semantics stops scoring. Post-access remedy remains development and consumes all exposed selected studies.
Record article correction/retraction/status scope explicitly; absence of annotation is not clearance.

scientific_limits: The technical size band can correlate with study size; four metadata-selected studies are not representative of all IntAct or human biology.
Source human-protein eligibility, eligible sample size, negative/expanded strata and biological context remain completely unknown.
The filename hash order is this project's reproducible selection rule, not an externally validated scientific benchmark.
Curated source records intentionally enter the importer; source fidelity cannot prove claim truth, prediction gain, novel biology or absence from Pharos.
Release pathname alone is not immutability; saved directory timestamps are later than the named release. Exact source-body hashes/HTTP receipts would be required later.
